text: {"lessons":["Before selling a stock, I’ll check whether my reason still holds; selling Stock B at a loss and later buying it again warns me against unplanned reversals.","I’ll set position-size and downside limits before adding, especially after sharp rises, rather than letting repeated purchases concentrate risk.","I’ll judge results over many periods against the market and a clear plan, not treat a winning sale or a single month’s account move as proof that my approach works."]}
